title: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 5.2 Decimal Operations: Add and subtract decimals
summary: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, 5.2 Decimal Operations: Add and subtract decimals
body: OpenStax Prealgebra 2e, section "5.2 Decimal Operations", prints these objectives: "Add and subtract decimals" "Multiply decimals" "Divide decimals" "Use decimals in money applications". The section text says: "Let’s take one more look at the lunch order from the start of Decimals , this time noticing how the numbers were added together." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
